## Academic Honors

**St. Lawrence History Honors** — May 2026

**Dean’s List** — Fall 2025

**Dean’s Incentive Award** — August 2022 – May 2026

## Honor Societies

**Chi Alpha Sigma** — inducted May 2026  
National College Athlete Honor Society, recognizing student athletes who maintain a GPA of 3.4 or above after their sophomore year.

**Phi Alpha Theta** — inducted April 2025  
National History Honor Society, recognizing academic excellence in the study of history.



## Athletic Honors

**Liberty League All-Academic Team** — 2023–2024, 2024–2025, 2025–2026  
Awarded to varsity student athletes in the Liberty League maintaining a GPA above 3.30.
